publicationChanges.reason: Omit a private local folder path from the public edition. The recorded prompt sha256 attests the unredacted prompt the reviewer received; only the two folder paths differ.

reviewLimits: Complete independent baseline/candidate comparisons were followed by local repairs; they are not a blind test of every claim in the final artifact.

A subsequent narrow read-back used a fixed key and one isolated language-model reader per condition. Two of three points were already recovered in the control; the revised text also conveyed the household authorization missing from the closing account.
Two final copyedits followed that narrow read-back. An independent informed director read the complete preceding manuscript and reread the two corrected chapters; this was not a second blind reading.

The retainedCutReview records the 28 September review of six succession Cuts within the then-current 108-Cut edition. Subsequent revisions extended the numerical account and reassessed readings affected by changed descriptions; fifty of the current 120 Cuts have a recorded textual basis and the other 70 retain untracked text freshness.
Recorded textual bases support checking whether a reading has changed, not numerical calibration, recovered historical evidence or psychological truth.
Telling-phase currency verifies recorded text and order, not reader psychology or semantic truth.
These limited readings are not the controlled evaluation proposed in the paper and do not recertify historical claims.

retainedCutReview.scope: The August 1852 succession episode: a current attributed content review of six retained Cuts, including their questions, conditioning, carrier scope, source Event and prose.
retainedCutReview.currentTextTracking: The six new signatures cover their assessment carrier texts. The resolving UnderstandingNode separately links to E20 and the supporting passages. Historical untracked evidence is not reconstructed.
retainedCutReview.independentReader: Informed content review, not a blinded or calibrated numerical evaluation.

currentModelAnchorMeaning: Current model anchors address identical native world records in the publication root. Historical reviewed hashes in assessment text remain unchanged; this remapping is not a new assessment.
reviewHashQualification: Historical review hashes continue to identify their original reviewed material. The old Book blind-reader prompt retains the hash of the prompt originally received; its public text has only its two local folder prefixes removed.
